newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANI to build U.S. steel plant.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANI to build U.S. steel plant.

text.p: Australian National Industries Ltd (ANI) said on Thursday it plans to spend US$55 million on a steel fabricating plant project in Oregon, in the U.S.
ANI said the facility would have 130,000 tonnes per annum capacity and would be located in Portland, Oregon.

It said the plant would manufacture steel tubes and include coating facility for tubular products, a slitting line, cutting equipment and additional warehouse capacity. It said full scale production was scheduled from the first half of calendar 1999.

The operation would be located in the Rivergate Industrial Park alongside Oregon Steel Mills Inc which would provide most of the steel coil feed for the new mill from its new hot strip facility due for completion in mid-1997, ANI said.
The West Coast market was the fastest growing in the U.S., ANI managing director Peter Stancliffe said in a sattement.

"As the only producer situated in the Northwest region, we will be ideally positioned to supply not only the region itself, including Western Canada, but also, given our seaboard location, other Pacific Rim markets," Stancliffe said.

"This regional step-out is a significant financial commitment for ANI but is consistent with our broad strategy to focus expansion of ANI in the areas of our greatest strength and expertise and only in markets which offer promise of sound continuing returns," he said.
